edits.text: 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to evaluate a potential transaction (the “Purpose”). Each party may disclose nonpublic information relating to its business or the potential transaction, in any form, that is identified as confidential or reasonably should be understood to be confidential (“Confidential Information”). The existence and status of discussions and the terms of any proposals are also Confidential Information. Neither party is obligated to disclose information or proceed with a transaction.

2. CONFIDENTIALITY AND USE. Each receiving party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose, protect it with at least reasonable care, and disclose it only to its directors, officers, employees, professional advisers, and financing sources who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations or professional duties of confidentiality. The receiving party is responsible for breaches by those representatives. Confidential Information excludes information the receiving party can demonstrate is publicly available without breach, was lawfully known to it without restriction before disclosure, is lawfully received from a third party without confidentiality restrictions, or is independently developed without use of Confidential Information. A receiving party may disclose information to the extent legally required, provided it gives prompt advance notice where legally permitted, reasonably cooperates in seeking protective treatment, and discloses only what is legally required. Upon written request, the receiving party shall return or destroy Confidential Information, except that it may retain copies required by law or professional retention obligations and information in routine backups, in each case subject to this Agreement.

3. TERM. This Agreement takes effect on the date of the last signature and remains in effect for twenty-four months. The confidentiality and use obligations survive expiration or termination for three years; for information qualifying as a trade secret under applicable law, those obligations continue for as long as the information remains a trade secret.

4. REMEDIES. Each party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which damages may not be an adequate remedy. The disclosing party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief, subject to applicable law, in addition to other available remedies.

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY AND USE. Each receiving party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose, protect it with at least reasonable care, and disclose it only to its directors, officers, employees, professional advisers, and financing sources who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations or professional duties of confidentiality. The receiving party is responsible for breaches by those representatives. Confidential Information excludes information the receiving party can demonstrate is publicly available without breach, was lawfully known to it without restriction before disclosure, is lawfully received from a third party without confidentiality restrictions, or is independently developed without use of Confidential Information. A receiving party may disclose information to the extent legally required, provided it gives prompt advance notice where legally permitted, reasonably cooperates in seeking protective treatment, and discloses only what is legally required. The receiving party shall promptly notify the disclosing party upon becoming aware of any unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information and shall take reasonable steps to mitigate its effects and prevent recurrence. Upon written request, the receiving party shall promptly return or destroy Confidential Information and certify in writing its compliance with that request, except that it may retain copies required by law or professional retention obligations and information in routine backups. Any retained materials shall remain subject to the confidentiality and use obligations of this Agreement for the periods specified in Section 3 and shall be inaccessible for ordinary business use.

3. TERM. This Agreement takes effect on the date of the last signature and remains in effect for twenty-four months. The confidentiality and use obligations survive expiration or termination for five years; for information qualifying as a trade secret under applicable law, those obligations continue for as long as the information remains a trade secret.

4. REMEDIES. Each party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which damages may not be an adequate remedy. The disclosing party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief, subject to applicable law, in addition to other available remedies.

5. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. Each party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state courts located in the Borough of Manhattan, New York City, and the federal courts of the United States located there, for any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Agreement, and waives any objection to venue or claim that such forum is inconvenient.
